Dave Matthews Band
July 29, 2023
iTHINK Financial Amphitheatre
West Palm Beach, Florida

Taper: Mark Terrell
Location: Stage Right venue support beam, if it was a seat it would be at Section 7, Row J,
Seat 31 if there was a seat there but that spot is empty for the beam. Literally the row at
the back of the club seats. 12' high.
Source: Audio Technica 853s (w/ 4.7k mod) > Tascam DR-05X (24/48)
Lineage: WAV > Audacity 2.3.2 (Gain, Mixing, Normalizing, Fades, Tracking) > FLAC (Level 8)

Setlist:
01. Introduction
02. The Stone
03. Big Eyed Fish >
04. Bartender
05. Madman's Eyes
06. Drunken Soldier
07. Granny
08. Old Dirt Hill (Bring That Beat Back)
09. Raven
10. The Only Thing
11. Lie in Our Graves
12. All You Wanted Was Tomorrow
13. Late in the Evening
14. All Along the Watchtower
15. Virginia in the Rain
16. Typical Situation
17. I Want You (She's So Heavy) >
18. After Everything
19. Corn Bread >
20. Ants Marching
---------------------------
21. Encore Break
22. Christmas Song
23. Crush

Dave Matthews Band:
Dave Matthews - Guitar, Lead Vocals
Tim Reynolds - Electric Guitar
Stefan Lessard - Bass
Buddy Strong - Keyboards, Vocals
Rashawn Ross - Trumpet, Vocals
Jeff Coffin - Saxophone, Flute
Carter Beauford - Drums

N2 at West Palm was, to date, the best DMB show I have seen. The opening run is amazing,
and the crowd's energy was next level all show. DMB was on fire, and I am so glad to have
been there. Overall, the great N1 and epic N2 make it the best 2 night stand I've seen
from the band. RIP to Zach, whose favorite song was Raven... very fitting tribute tonight
to have it in the set for a local Florida show. Robert taped at the board for this one
and no doubt pulled an epic tape.

Thanks to the West Palm Beach venue for being accomodating and kind to tapers.
Shout out to Noam Yemini, who we missed at the shows this year - still supporting from afar!
Thank you to Ryan Jonik from NINLive.com for the gear.
Thank you to Tommy from the DMB sound team for his constant support of the DMB taping scene.

Compiled by Mark Terrell on 2023/08/06.
